Travel Your Way.
Go Deeper.
modules.body:
Three flexible service options for independent travelers, families and small groups.
Clear starting prices. Direct local contact. Tailored to you.
modules.note: All prices shown are starting references. Final pricing depends on your route, travel dates, group size and service needs.

modules.title: Choose Your Level of Support
modules.body: From independent planning with local guidance to a fully designed private journey.
modules.note: USD 99, USD 299 and USD 699 are starting references. Road Trip and Signature prices are not per-person or complete-package prices. The pricing basis and service scope are confirmed in your written quote.

modules.body: The prices shown above are starting prices. Your final quotation depends on your route, travel dates, number of travelers, vehicle type and service needs.

modules.title: Our Vehicles & Drivers
modules.body: Road trips and private journeys can include English-speaking drivers and comfortable or premium SUVs selected for your route, group size and comfort needs.
modules.note: Illustrative concepts only. Vehicle class and availability are confirmed for each route. Li Auto, ONVO L90 and Land Rover are examples, never guaranteed models.

modules.title:
You Bring the Idea.
We Help With the Rest.
modules.body: Traveling in China can feel overwhelming if you’re doing everything on your own. With Lumichan, you can stay flexible while getting the local support you actually need.

services.title: Journey Planning & Local Support
services.subtitle: Plan it yourself. Travel with a local expert in your pocket.
points: Local guidance before and during the trip
included: Personalized itinerary planning
Digital travel planning booklet
Hotel and local transportation recommendations
Help with payments, mobile connectivity and pre-trip preparation
Guidance on insurance and practical travel questions
Online assistance during your journey
Local recommendations when plans change
services.bestFor: Independent travelers who want freedom with a trusted local contact.

image.alt: AI illustration: Journey Planning & Local Support
image.licenseRecord: Supplied service-page prototype assets, 2026-10-27; illustration only

services.title: Private Road Trip
services.subtitle: Your own car. Your own pace. No tour-bus timetable.
points: Comfortable or premium SUV selected for your route
A practical choice for families and small groups
included: Personalized route and pre-trip support
Private vehicle throughout the confirmed journey
English-speaking driver
Vehicle matched to route, group size and actual availability
Hotel and restaurant recommendations
Booking assistance and local support on the road
Insurance, welcome meal and gift only as specified in the written quote
services.bestFor: Travelers who want private transport and a flexible pace, especially on routes where local driving support helps.

image.licenseRecord: Supplied service-page prototype assets, 2026-10-27; illustration only

services.title: Signature Private Journey
services.subtitle: Designed around you — not around a standard itinerary.
points: Fully customized around your travel style
English-speaking driver and upgraded vehicle when quoted
Premium support and deeper local access
included: One-to-one journey planning and travel concierge
Private vehicle and English-speaking driver in the agreed itinerary
Guide or interpreter when quoted
Selected hotels, restaurants and cultural experiences when quoted
Local experts and special-interest visits subject to availability
Insurance, priority support, welcome meal and gift only as specified in the written quote
services.bestFor: Travelers seeking privacy, flexibility and carefully coordinated cultural experiences.
